02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE LENS

Timi Dawodu.
Many crafts.
One point of view.

A filmmaker, visual storyteller and multidisciplinary creative. Timi Called The Shots brings my cinematography, direction, filmmaking, photography and editing into one place.

Whether it’s a music video, a brand story or a photograph, the intention stays the same: make something that means something.
